newsitem.title: USA: Boston Tech buys Enhanced Communications.
newsitem.headline: Boston Tech buys Enhanced Communications.

text.p: Boston Technology Inc said it has acquired Enhanced Communications Corp, in a stock for stock transaction.
The company said it expects that the acquisition will be accounted for as a pooling of interests.

Enhanced Communications Corporation is a service bureau providing voice messaging platforms for BellSouth Telecommunications, and BellSouth Personal Communications. These companies then lease mailboxes off of their platforms to provide voice messaging services for their customers.

"This acquisition will allow Boston Technology to expand its offerings to its service provider customers, through a service bureau type operation, to go along with the sale and license of its platforms and software," said Francis Girard, president and chief executive of Boston Technology.
